stem.text: The diagram shows two cylinders of agar.
The agar cylinders are placed into a solution of dye at the same time. The time taken for the dye to diffuse into the centre of each cylinder is recorded.

stem.alt: Two cylinders drawn side by side, labelled X and Y, with length and width dimensions printed as 5 cm, 2 cm, 3 cm and 1 cm.

stem.text: Which statement explains why the dye reaches the centre of one agar cylinder faster than the other agar cylinder?

A.text: The dye reaches the centre of X in a shorter time than the dye reaches the centre of Y because X has a larger surface area to volume ratio.

B.text: The dye reaches the centre of X in a shorter time than the dye reaches the centre of Y because X has a larger surface area.

C.text: The dye reaches the centre of Y in a shorter time than the dye reaches the centre of X because the dye has a shorter distance to diffuse to the centre.

D.text: The dye reaches the centre of Y in a shorter time than the dye reaches the centre of X because Y has a smaller volume.
